Harvest Beef Casserole
Serves 4 to 6

1 1/2 lb (675 g) lean ground beef
1 medium onion, chopped
1 green pepper, diced
1 can (10 oz / 284 ml) condensed tomato soup
1 tbsp (15 ml) Worcestershire sauce
1 tsp (5 ml) dried thyme
1 1/2 cups (375 ml) frozen corn
4 cups (1 L) mashed potatoes
1/2 cup (125 ml) grated Cheddar

Garnish (optional): chopped fresh parsley, a dusting of paprika

In a large skillet, brown beef with onion and green pepper; drain fat.
Stir in soup, Worcestershire and thyme; simmer 5 minutes.
Spread in a 2-quart casserole. Top with corn, then potatoes.
Sprinkle with Cheddar. Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 25 to 30 minutes
until bubbly. Sprinkle with garnish before serving.

Serving tip: Serve with a crisp green salad and crusty rolls.
